body:
One further independent-review blocker was accepted after the previous rescan request: tag names and tag-based URLs are not immutable evidence. The current draft is now SHA-256 ed586870478e123c804604f8180de4841f8d8dd8addbba3abf40b378a60add2f, 279 lines, no trailing whitespace.

FFmpeg licence/configure evidence and PySceneDetect licence/inventory/interface/manifest evidence now use full commit coordinates. Evidence-freshness rows treat commits/content digests as stable coordinates, require tag-to-object mappings to be revalidated, and explicitly recheck mutable release, legal, PyPI, issue, security, dependency, and vulnerability records at realization.

Please use ed586870 as the final-rescan target; eff6a98 is superseded. The court remains Held and no execution or higher gate is claimed.
